description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class EmployeeDependentDao within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for CRUD operations and searches related to employee dependents, including fetching dependents, saving dependents, deleting, and searching with filters.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing employee dependents, handling database interactions such as retrieval, insertion, update, deletion, and search functionalities.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves all dependents for a given employee number, ordered by name.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Fetches a specific dependent for an employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingDependentIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the sequence IDs of dependents matching provided IDs for a specific employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves an employee dependent; if sequence number is not set, generates the next sequence number, and validates it.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes dependents for an employee based on a list of sequence IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Performs a search for dependents based on filter parameters and returns the results.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentPaginator
methods.description: Prepares a paginated query for dependents filtered by employee number, name, and relationship type.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of dependents matching search filter parameters.
